title: ISO 8601 Week Calendar
intro: ISO 8601 week dates identify a day by its week-numbering year, week number and weekday instead of month and day.
structure: Weeks run Monday (1) through Sunday (7). Week 1 contains 4 January, equivalently the year's first Thursday. A week-numbering year has 52 or 53 complete weeks.
example: Thursday 1 January 2026 is 2026-W01-4; Monday 29 December 2025 is 2026-W01-1.
history: ISO 8601 standardises dates and week numbering for international scheduling, research and records.
model: The provider derives week coordinates from proleptic Gregorian civil dates. The Monday of Week 1 starts the ISO year; the next year's corresponding Monday defines its end. A Gregorian date near New Year can belong to an adjacent ISO week year.
limits: There are no official ISO month or quarter subdivisions in this week notation. Historical back-projection is mathematical, not evidence of contemporary usage.
